items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: Bob was interviewed by Monk Rowe at Hamilton College on October 6, 1996.

ctx.x: He was attracted to the drums at an early age and used his skills to earn a scholarship to the University of Michigan. After performing with military bands during the mid-40s, he moved to New York and found work with saxophonist Alvy West. His versatility and reading skills helped him find constant work in the studios where he performed on recordings with Duke Ellington, Miles Davis and Gil Evans. Bob was interviewed by Monk Rowe at Hamilton College on October 6, 1996.
Bob’s wife Sharon participated briefly in the interview.
